verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles documents building identity-resolved customer 360 profiles as warehouse-native tables from declarative YAML, which gives a queryable profile store. A marketing page also claims the customer 360 can be accessed 'through a real-time API', but no profile API reference appears in the API docs evidence. Missing for 10: documented profile/real-time API reference, explicit evidence that profiles expose identifiers and event history alongside traits, documentation of how the profile store is queried, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can query unified customer profiles — traits, identifiers, event history — through a documented profile API or store

citations.quote: Resolve identities and build a customer 360 in your warehouse.

you declare entities and their attributes in version-controlled YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL that handles identity resolution, incremental computation, and feature aggregation automatically.
Push your customer 360 to business tools or access it through a real-time API.
Seamlessly generate identity graphs from any combination of unique identifiers across any number data sources.
